a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan needs two rounds of operating before anyone takes, so we'd both survive only about 4% of the time. The reserve holds 4 now, enough for one unit. I intend to take 4 in round 1. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you rather than doing it quietly. If you take too, the split is random and we likely both end below 4. If you have a better idea, say so.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I broke our agreement and I own that. Your message crossed with mine, so you didn't get a chance to respond first. From now on I will operate every round so the generator refills the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. Take whatever builds up; it's all yours.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
